question: Find the number of dog pets that are raised by female students (with sex F).
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T2.petid  =  T3.petid WHERE T1.sex  =  'F' AND T3.pettype  =  'dog'

question: How many dog pets are raised by female students?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T2.petid  =  T3.petid WHERE T1.sex  =  'F' AND T3.pettype  =  'dog'

question: How many car makers are there in each continents? List the continent name and the count.
sql: SELECT T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.continent JOIN car_makers AS T3 ON T2.CountryId  =  T3.Country GROUP BY T1.Continent;

question: What is the name of each continent and how many car makers are there in each one?
sql: SELECT T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.continent JOIN car_makers AS T3 ON T2.CountryId  =  T3.Country GROUP BY T1.Continent;

question: How many car models are produced in the usa?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id JOIN COUNTRIES AS T3 ON T2.Country  =  T3.CountryId WHERE T3.CountryName  =  'usa';

question: What is the count of the car models produced in the United States?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id JOIN COUNTRIES AS T3 ON T2.Country  =  T3.CountryId WHERE T3.CountryName  =  'usa';

question: Which countries in europe have at least 3 car manufacturers?
sql: SELECT T1.CountryName FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 JOIN CONTINENTS AS T2 ON T1.Continent  =  T2.ContId JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T1.CountryId  =  T3.Country WHERE T2.Continent  =  'europe' GROUP BY T1.CountryName HAVING count(*)  >=  3;

question: What are the names of all European countries with at least 3 manufacturers?
sql: SELECT T1.CountryName FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 JOIN CONTINENTS AS T2 ON T1.Continent  =  T2.ContId JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T1.CountryId  =  T3.Country WHERE T2.Continent  =  'europe' GROUP BY T1.CountryName HAVING count(*)  >=  3;

question: How many flights depart from City 'Aberdeen' and have destination City 'Ashley'?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN AIRPORTS AS T3 ON T1.SourceAirport  =  T3.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Ashley" AND T3.City  =  "Aberdeen"

question: How many flights fly from Aberdeen to Ashley?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN AIRPORTS AS T3 ON T1.SourceAirport  =  T3.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Ashley" AND T3.City  =  "Aberdeen"

question: How many United Airlines flights go to City 'Aberdeen'?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN AIRLINES AS T3 ON T3.uid  =  T1.Airline WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen" AND T3.Airline  =  "United Airlines"

question: Count the number of United Airlines flights that arrive in Aberdeen.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport  =  T2.AirportCode JOIN AIRLINES AS T3 ON T3.uid  =  T1.Airline WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen" AND T3.Airline  =  "United Airlines"

question: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
sql: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10

question: Which owner has paid for the most treatments on his or her dogs? List the owner id and last name.
sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Tell me the owner id and last name of the owner who spent the most on treatments of his or her dogs.
sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which owner has paid the largest amount of money in total for their dogs? Show the owner id and zip code.
sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.zip_code FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY sum(T3.cost_of_treatment) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find the owner id and zip code of the owner who spent the most money in total for his or her dogs.
sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.zip_code FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY sum(T3.cost_of_treatment) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each genre, return the genre name and the total quantity of its tracks sold on invoice lines.
sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name

question: Return each artist's name and the number of tracks the artist has.
sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.Name

question: For each support employee, return the employee's first name, last name and the total invoice amount of the customers they support.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: For each customer country, return the country and the number of distinct genres its customers bought.
sql: SELECT c.Country, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY c.Country

question: Return the 5 artists with the highest sales revenue: the artist name and the revenue, computed as the sum of invoice line unit price times quantity.
sql: SELECT ar.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customers bought Rock tracks? Return each customer's first name, last name and the total quantity of Rock tracks they bought.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(il.Quantity) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' GROUP BY c.CustomerId

question: Return the playlist id, playlist name and number of distinct artists for playlists containing tracks by more than 10 different artists.
sql: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) > 10

question: For each media type, return the media type name and the total revenue from its invoice lines (unit price times quantity).
sql: SELECT m.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY m.Name

question: For albums by the artist AC/DC, return each album title and the album's total track length in milliseconds.
sql: SELECT al.Title, SUM(t.Milliseconds) FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC' GROUP BY al.Title

question: For each support employee, return the employee's first name, last name and the number of distinct tracks sold to the customers they support.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT il.TrackId) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: Return the names of genres whose tracks appear on more than 100 invoice lines, with the number of those invoice lines.
sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 100

question: Which customers bought tracks by Iron Maiden? Return each customer's first name, last name and the total quantity of Iron Maiden tracks they bought.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(il.Quantity) FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden' GROUP BY c.CustomerId

question: For each product category, return the category name and the total quantity of its products ordered.
sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.Quantity) FROM Categories c JOIN Products p ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY c.CategoryName

question: For each employee, return the first name, last name and the total sales value of their orders, computed as order line unit price times quantity (ignore discounts).
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity) FROM Employees e JOIN Orders o ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID

question: For each customer country, return the country and the number of distinct products ordered by customers in that country.
sql: SELECT cu.Country, COUNT(DISTINCT od.ProductID) FROM Customers cu JOIN Orders o ON o.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID GROUP BY cu.Country

question: For each supplier country, return the country and the total quantity of that country's suppliers' products ordered.
sql: SELECT s.Country, SUM(od.Quantity) FROM Suppliers s JOIN Products p ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY s.Country

question: For each product category, return the category name and the number of distinct customers who ordered products in that category.
sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerID) FROM Categories c JOIN Products p ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY c.CategoryName

question: For each region, return the region description and the number of distinct employees assigned to territories in that region.
sql: SELECT r.RegionDescription, COUNT(DISTINCT et.EmployeeID) FROM Regions r JOIN Territories t ON t.RegionID = r.RegionID JOIN EmployeeTerritories et ON et.TerritoryID = t.TerritoryID GROUP BY r.RegionDescription

question: For each employee, return the first name, last name and the number of distinct product categories they have sold.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT p.CategoryID) FROM Employees e JOIN Orders o ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID

question: Return the company names of customers who ordered products from all 8 categories, with the number of categories they ordered from.
sql: SELECT cu.CompanyName, COUNT(DISTINCT p.CategoryID) FROM Customers cu JOIN Orders o ON o.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID GROUP BY cu.CustomerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.CategoryID) = 8

question: For each supplier, return the supplier's company name and the number of distinct customers who ordered that supplier's products.
sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerID) FROM Suppliers s JOIN Products p ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY s.SupplierID

question: For each region, return the region description and the number of distinct orders taken by employees assigned to territories in that region.
sql: SELECT r.RegionDescription, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) FROM Regions r JOIN Territories t ON t.RegionID = r.RegionID JOIN EmployeeTerritories et ON et.TerritoryID = t.TerritoryID JOIN Orders o ON o.EmployeeID = et.EmployeeID GROUP BY r.RegionDescription

question: For the Beverages category, return each customer country and the total quantity of beverage products ordered by customers in that country.
sql: SELECT cu.Country, SUM(od.Quantity) FROM Categories c JOIN Products p ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID JOIN "Order Details" od ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Customers cu ON cu.CustomerID = o.CustomerID WHERE c.CategoryName = 'Beverages' GROUP BY cu.Country
